transformation: Derived from CLTS v1.4.1 data/sounds.tsv (GRAPHEME, NAME columns). Established empirically on 2026-08-13 by diffing this inventory against every tagged CLTS release: v1.4.1 matches 768 of 769 graphemes and 766 of 769 byte-identical NAME strings, against 689 and 680 respectively for v2.0.0 and later, so v1.4.1 is the source. Three rows diverge and are kept as they are: z̻ is not a CLTS v1.4.1 sound; ʈʂː is named 'long voiceless retroflex sibilant affricate consonant' here where v1.4.1 says 'voiced', which was an upstream inconsistency with its own ʈʂ entry and was corrected upstream in v2.0.0; ⁿgǃ is named with 'click' where v1.4.1 says 'nasal-click'. Feature sets are computed from the NAME tokens by tools/generate_c_data.py; no CLTS feature values, sound classes, or grapheme mappings are used.
citation: List, Johann-Mattis, Cormac Anderson, Tiago Tresoldi, Christoph Rzymski, and Robert Forkel. Cross-Linguistic Transcription Systems (CLTS), version 1.4.1. Max Planck Institute for the Science of Human History. https://github.com/cldf-clts/clts (author list per the CLTS Zenodo record, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3515744).
